background.summary: ABF yield data is split across MES, QMS, inspection, and equipment systems. Quality and process teams need a unified view to identify yield loss by lot, panel, product, process step, equipment, and defect reason.
background.objective: Build a yield analysis workspace that standardizes yield definitions, exposes loss drivers, supports drill-down, and tracks abnormal closure.

in_scope: Lot, panel, product, and process-step analysis
Abnormal yield alerts and closure tracking

core_scenarios: Engineer reviews yield trend by product and process step.
User drills into a low-yield lot and checks defect Pareto.
Process owner creates an abnormal closure action.

functional_requirements.overview: This default example includes Yield KPI and trend, Defect Pareto drill-down, Abnormal closure tracking.
